svg.text: Schematic: use dimensions, do not scale. Dots are joints; crossings without dots are not joints.
Length m; force kN; line load kN/m per actual member length. Global Z up.
Three side faces projected on YZ. Each panel retains its actual axis coordinates; shared edges are repeated.

Both vertices retain distinct IDs; rings project to points.

Case D: all listed loads act together. Unlisted components are zero. Forces use global axes.
D-1 at L3V1: Fx=12 kN, Fy=0, Fz=-10 kN.
D-2 at L3V2: Fx=0, Fy=8 kN, Fz=-10 kN.
D-3 at L3V3: Fx=0, Fy=0, Fz=-10 kN.
All members: M1, axial-only. Verticals A1; rings A2; diagonals A3. Base L0V1/L0V2/L0V3: Ux=Uy=Uz=0.
All other translations are free; all nodal rotations are inactive and restrained. Repeated nodes in different panels are the same joints.
